resources.name: Electricity (kWh at utility tariff)
resources.rail: the utility's own distribution grid and monthly billing account
resources.unit: kWh, priced in USD per the utility's own tariff

resources.name: Distributed-generation credit (net-metered kWh)
resources.rail: the utility's internal net-metering ledger, credited against the household's USD-denominated bill
resources.unit: kWh credited against a future USD-denominated bill

resources.name: Propane (gallon)
resources.rail: physical delivery by tank truck to an on-site propane tank
resources.unit: gallon, priced in USD per the distributor's posted or contracted rate

resources.name: Diesel / heating oil (gallon)
resources.rail: physical delivery or retail pump purchase

resources.name: Cordwood
resources.rail: informal/local retail or self-harvested; physical delivery, no chain
resources.unit: cord, priced in USD where sold; self-harvested wood carries no dollar price but a labor and land cost

resources.name: LIHEAP grant (federal, state-administered)
resources.rail: the state agency's own benefit-disbursement process
resources.unit: USD per household per heating season

resources.name: Tribal LIHEAP grant (Oglala Sioux Tribe)
resources.rail: the Tribe's own district service centers, run in parallel to, not through, the state DSS LIHEAP office
resources.unit: USD per household per program period; specific benefit amount not found

resources.name: Federal residential clean-energy tax credit (Section 25D)
resources.rail: the household's own federal income tax return (Form 5695), nonrefundable, carried forward against future tax liability
resources.unit: USD (30% of qualified solar/battery-storage installation expenditure), nonrefundable

resources.name: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC)
resources.unit: one REC per MWh generated from a qualifying renewable source

resources.name: Interconnection queue position (Oceti Sakowin Power Authority)
resources.rail: SPP's own interconnection queue process; an administrative rail, not a chain or platform ledger
resources.unit: one queue position per named generation project

resources.name: Transmission access / corridor land along a route
resources.rail: federal/state permitting and right-of-way easement process along the physical corridor route
resources.unit: linear route-miles of right-of-way across named reservations

resources.name: Water rights touched by a capital project
resources.rail: state permitting and treaty/tribal water-rights law
resources.unit: unknown (no first-party figure for a specific plant's water draw or a specific water-rights allocation)

resources.name: Consultation rights (structural claim held as an option)
resources.rail: federal/state environmental and permitting review processes (consultation requirements, PUC review, treaty rights)
resources.unit: one consultation-rights claim per project/permitting proceeding

resources.name: Wit
resources.unit: wit (one witnessed distinction-step; physically, kT ln 2 per erased bit)

resources.name: Joule
resources.rail: the house's own sizing schema: position-sizing-service's barrierJoules field
resources.unit: joule (J); kWh is the practical household-scale unit, 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ

resources.name: USDC (x402 gateway settlement)
resources.rail: Base (Coinbase L2), via the x402 gateway
